attempts.name: mfn_poFindSoundSemaphore__19CSoundSemaphoreContFi
attempts.reason: Inline stree::find (lower_bound + operator== + _Mynode/_Key/less::operator() + ternary end():it) reproduces every call and the value access (node+0x14). Residual is the usnd iterator copy semantics: the retail find() copies its lower_bound result with a CONSTRUCTOR call (iterator_base(sTreeLink*)) and returns through another constructor call, while the retail erase() initialises its by-value iterator parameter with a TRIVIAL memberwise copy (lw/sw of _Ptr).
